functions.name: today
functions.description: Today, 00:00 local time

functions.name: now
functions.description: The current date and time

functions.name: formatDate
functions.description: Writes a date as text. Pattern letters: yyyy year, MM month, dd day, HH:mm:ss time, EEE weekday, MMMM month name, 'text' in quotes

functions.name: parseDate
functions.description: Reads a date from text with a pattern like formatDate

functions.name: addDays
functions.description: Adds days; negative numbers go back

functions.name: addHours
functions.description: Adds hours

functions.name: addMonths
functions.description: Adds months

functions.name: dayOfWeek
functions.description: Weekday: 1 Monday … 7 Sunday

functions.name: diffDays
functions.description: Days from one date to another

functions.name: upper
functions.description: Text in capital letters

functions.name: lower
functions.description: Text in small letters

functions.name: trim
functions.description: Removes spaces at the start and end

functions.name: replace
functions.description: Replaces all occurrences

functions.name: replaceRegex
functions.description: Replaces every match of a regular expression (write patterns with \ in backticks, e.g. `\d+`); new may use groups as $1 or ${name}, $$ for a $

functions.name: split
functions.description: Splits text into a list

functions.name: padLeft
functions.description: Fills on the left up to a length, e.g. 007; fill defaults to a space

functions.name: padRight
functions.description: Fills on the right up to a length

functions.name: substr
functions.description: Part of a text, counting from 0; length is optional

functions.name: left
functions.description: The first n characters

functions.name: right
functions.description: The last n characters

functions.name: concat
functions.description: Joins values with a separator and leaves out empty ones, so no separator stands alone; lists count with their entries

functions.name: normalize
functions.description: Replaces umlauts and ß, joins spaces – e.g. for file names

functions.name: basename
functions.description: Last part of a path or address, e.g. the file name; / and \ both separate

functions.name: dirname
functions.description: The path without its last part, e.g. the folder of a file; empty without a folder

functions.name: ext
functions.description: Ending of the file name with its dot, e.g. .zip; empty without one

functions.name: len
functions.description: Number of characters, entries of a list or keys of a map

functions.name: round
functions.description: Rounds to a whole number

functions.name: sum
functions.description: Sum of a list of numbers

functions.name: map
functions.description: Takes a field of each entry, e.g. the sizes of files

functions.name: filter
functions.description: Keeps the entries for which the condition is true

functions.name: join
functions.description: Joins a list of texts

functions.name: coalesce
functions.description: The first value that is not empty

functions.name: isEmpty
functions.description: Whether a value is empty: nothing, empty text, list or map
